title: Separator level control
description: Operate a level-controlled separator. Observe how LIC-101 compares the measured level (LT-101) against its setpoint and drives the discharge control valve LV-101, and respond when the transmitter develops a fault.
learningObjectives: Understand the relationship between inflow, outflow, measured level and controller output.
Compare automatic and manual controller modes.
Recognise high-level alarm and high-high trip behaviour.

events.description: LT-101 has failed and is now reading a frozen value.

tasks.text: Return the level to 40-60% and hold it there for 20 seconds.
Avoid a high-high level trip (never exceed 90%).

completionFeedback.onPass: The separator level was recovered and held within range without tripping — good control room practice.
completionFeedback.onFail: The level was not stabilised in time, or exceeded the safe range. Review how LIC-101 responded to the transmitter fault at t=60s.

safetyConstraints: If LT-101 fails, the automatic controller is operating on bad data — switch to manual and use other evidence before continuing.
